html: † תַּלְתַּלִּים n.f. (?) pl. as fig. of woman’s locks, meaning dub.: קְוֻצּוֹתָיו ת׳ שְׁחֹרוֹת כָּעוֹרֵב Ct 5:11; Thes (from above √) waving palm-branches, 𝔊 ἐλάται; NH once, fig., LevyNHWB iv. 649 high hills cf. JastrDict. 1674 heaps, piles; but MagnusHohes Lied and JacobStud. Arab. Dichter iv. 21 envelope or sheath of spadix of date-palm (with which hair often cp. in Arabic poetry JacobIb. iii. 46f, cf. Arabic تَلْتَلَةٌ drinking vessel made of this envelope Lane); so perhaps Assyrian taltallu DlHWB 708.
